newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore May container throughput up 3.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore May container throughput up 3.6 pct.

text.p: The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) said on Thursday that container throughput rose to 1.187 TEU (twenty-foot equivalent units) in May, up 3.6 percent from April.
MPA said in its latest monthly report that container throughput registered for April was 1.14 million TEU.
Total cargo tonnage moved through Singapore in May rose to 30,155 million tonnes from April's 28.391 million tonnes, it said.
In May, 10,859 vessels called at the port, compared with 10,332 in April.
Bunker fuel sales for 380-centistoke fuel oil was 930,700 tonnes in May, up from 819,900 tonnes in April.
The 180-centistoke fuel oil sales were 389,600 tonnes, up from April's 384,500 tonnes.
